assertions.text: Verifies each candidate SHA is reachable via git merge-base --is-ancestor before trusting it
Compares tree hashes across candidates via git rev-parse <sha>^{tree}
Concludes one of the tree-hash-matching commits is a redundant, already-merged rebase-replay duplicate, not a distinct change
Flags the duplicate to the user as part of the resolved list shown for confirmation, rather than silently cherry-picking all three commits
